content:
Maria: heads-up team — webinar titled 'Inference Unlocked' set for next Thurs. need X + LinkedIn schedule, lead routing, and a short benchmark narrative to push in the threads. who can own hero assets?

Sophie: I can own hero + 3 micro-variants (desktop crop, mobile crop, carousel frames). putting files in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd/inference-unlocked. will tag variants with region suffix.

Ash: draft copy below — keep options tight please:
- Short: "Inference Unlocked: reduce inference cost, keep latency predictable. Free live demo — RSVP -> [link]"
- Narrative: "Stop settling for slow or expensive inference. Join our engineering demo to see predictable serving patterns and cost tactics. Q&A included. RSVP -> [link]"

Jake: good split. recommend Short for X, Narrative for LinkedIn long post. for LinkedIn carousel use Narrative as first card then 2 cards of benchmarks + demo screenshot.

Olivia: routing — use HubSpot list: "Webinar — Inference Unlocked Q2" (HS_5019). Zapier flow exists to create contact + task; SDR slack alert channel should be #sdr-leads.

Tomas: SLA: follow up to high-intent registrants (attendees + clicked demo CTAs) within 12 hours. rotation: primary 8am–4pm PST, backup 4pm–12am PST. I'll add to /docs/sdr-playbooks/webinar-inference-unlocked.md with scripts.

Maria: thumbs-up on SLA. marketing goal: top-level metrics to report in postmortem: impressions, CTR, reg rate, cost/reg (if boosted), demo sign rate, and thread sentiment. include heatmap of comment times.

Jake: timing windows proposal (UTC posted in calendar):
- Americas: X 15:30 UTC / LinkedIn 17:00 UTC
- EMEA: X 09:00 UTC / LinkedIn 10:30 UTC
- APAC: X 01:00 UTC / LinkedIn 02:30 UTC
Stagger by region to maximize global reach and repurpose hero assets.

Sophie: can deliver localized microcopy for EMEA (English + DE/FR) and APAC (EN + ZH/JP) if someone signs off on final headlines by Tue EOD.

Ash: engagement plan:
- T0: publish + first 30 min real-time replies from community team (short answers + CTA)
- T+4h: follow thread push from product account with benchmark snapshot
- T+18h: SDR outreach to registrants with engagement >= threshold (email + LinkedIn message)
- T+48h: nurture: on-demand link + 1-pager download

Maria: what about paid lift? Olivia?

Olivia: propose $1.5k total split across LinkedIn Sponsored Content (60%) and X promoted post (40%). target: platform engineers & ML infra titles at mid-market/enterprise. setup in campaign manager after A/B headline winner.

Jake: A/B idea — test whether a data-first headline (benchmarks up front) beats curiosity-first. LinkedIn split 50/50. Metric: registration rate. use winner for paid creative by 24h.

Maria: tooling — @social-bot, which scheduler do we have hooked to Redwood accounts? Buffer or Sprout? need API link for programmatic schedule.

social-bot: Sprout connected for LinkedIn; Buffer connected for X. Both have scheduling APIs. recommend Buffer for thread scheduling; Sprout for carousel publishing. Pass times in UTC. :robot_face:

Ash: small copy tweaks — shorten X hooks to <200 chars, add 1 question at end to drive replies. will produce final variants by Tue noon.

Sophie: uploaded 3 mockups with CTA placement options. tagged @Ash and @Maria.

Tomas: drafting SDR message samples now (2 email templates, 1 LinkedIn InMail). will link to playbook when done.

Olivia: I'll provision the HubSpot form mapping and include a hidden field for campaign_id=IUQ2_0426. also creating the retargeting audience based on pageviews + partial signers.

Maria: final decision on thread format — I'm leaning toward an X thread: main post + 2 follow replies (benchmarks, demo screenshot). LinkedIn we do a single post + carousel. agree?

Jake: agree. thread outline: main hook -> bench snapshot reply -> demo tease + CTA reply. schedule the last reply ~20 min after main to capture momentum.

Maria: excellent. action items recap: Sophie (assets), Ash (final copy), Jake (schedules + A/B tracking), Olivia (HubSpot & paid budget), Tomas (SDR playbook). reconvene Wed 10am PT for final sign-off. thanks everyone!
